# Neural Network Architectures

Modern artificial intelligence relies on dense matrix transformations and scaled dot-product attention mechanisms.

## Attention Formulation

The attention map for queries $Q$, keys $K$, and values $V$ with dimension $d_k$ is formulated as:

$$
\text{Attention}(Q, K, V) = \text{softmax}\left(\frac{QK^T}{\sqrt{d_k}}\right) V
$$
